Sun & Moon series · UNB

Unbroken Bonds

Released May 3, 2019 · 234 cards

Expanded

Unbroken Bonds is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on May 3, 2019. Its main set has 214 cards, plus 20 secret rares numbered beyond the set (234 in total). It includes 196 Pokémon, 40 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

65 illustrators worked on Unbroken Bonds. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (20), aky CG Works (7), Ken Sugimori (7), Mitsuhiro Arita (7), Anesaki Dynamic (6), Shin Nagasawa (6), kirisAki (5), Midori Harada (5).
